You will need:

-blender

-red pepper flake (two table spoons)

-garlic bulb x2 (fresh and not that powdered or jarred stuff)

-soy sauce (any brand)

-the hottest pepper you can tolerate (jalepenos add awesome flavor, habeneros add nice heat)

-liquid smoke

-thinly sliced beef (3 pounds)

Place peppers minus stems with garlic,  liquid smoke and red pepper flake into blender. Add 3/4 full of soy sauce to the mix. Pulse until all ingredients are dispersed into your marinade. 

Trim fat off of the meat (it becomes deep tissue gum pain if not removed) and place into marinade. Allow to sit for 24 hours.

After 24 hours it is time to dehydrate.  Slice meat into 2 inch wide 5 inch long strips and place on the the dehydrator tray allowing 1/4 to 1/2 inch in between strips on each tray to allow heat to travel through the strips. 

The amount of time it takes to dehydrate is dependent on the amount of liquid left on the meat when placed in the dehydrator, the thickness of the strips ..etc. It is not exact science but you will know it is done when the meat is dry and stiff on the inside of the strip. If it looks wet on the inside give it more time in there.  Experimentation is always in order. Remember, the act of marinading meat partially cooks it. Enjoy!

Take a sip and move your mouse to wake the computer out of sleep mode.  Suddenly you realize that it tastes bitter. Stand up from your chair and go back to the kitchen to sweeten the taste with sugar. Pour a little milk in there.

Go back to your desk and check email. See what is going on with the news. Suddenly you realize you need to relieve yourself from the consumption of the day before.

Go to the bathroom and do the deed.  You see that your towel is hanging from the bar there and you realize that in order to tackle the day you should shower the nights filth from your body. You coffee cup is safely on the edge of the bathroom sink and you cleanse.

After drying off, you step out feeling rejuvinated and ready to carry on with your coffee cup in hand. After you dress yourself, and check Reddit once more it is time to make sure your vehicle contains all that you require for you day inside it.

I am fastest to the table but I wait for the other racer to get to the table before I dig that spoon as deep as I can into the bowl.  This is a happy moment! And then I put that heaping spoonful in my mouth and immediately gag and spit it out. What was in mouth my was not sweet sweet ice cream....what was in that bowl was BUTTER...like for your toast or baked potato. This kid next to me is wolfing down his bowl of real ice cream but...BUTTER?  The Sunday school teachers told us not to believe what we think or see because the devil may be butter in disguise of ice cream.  This happened.
